title: 年顺差1.2万亿美元：外汇储备却停在3万亿，贸易渠道流出的美元去了哪？
speaker: How Hall

segments.en: Yeah. You talked to me about the yen, well, the, the yen carry trade.
segments.zh: 对，你跟我聊过日元，嗯，日元套利交易。

segments.en: Yeah. You're saying something that markets seem to be overlooking here, right?
segments.zh: 对，你提到了一些市场似乎忽视的东西，对吧？

segments.en: Can you explain a little bit? Yeah. Well, I think if you look at the Chinese foreign currency reserve, right?
segments.zh: 能稍微解释一下吗？好，我觉得如果你看中国的外汇储备，对吧？

segments.en: So year in the year, we produce like 1.2 trillion US dollars worth of trade surplus.
segments.zh: 每年我们产生大约1.2万亿美元的贸易顺差。

segments.en: But then I think the Chinese foreign reserve hasn't moved for a long time.
segments.zh: 但我觉得中国的外汇储备很久没动了。

segments.en: Right? So ever since 2015, it's been stuck at, you know, three trillion also, US dollars for a very long time.
segments.zh: 对吧？所以自2015年以来，它一直停留在，你知道，三万亿，也是美元，很长时间了。

segments.en: So you have, you've got to wonder where did this US dollar go, right?
segments.zh: 所以你得想想这些美元去哪了，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah. Because, you know, we're making so much money. And so obviously, you know, a lot of the rich Chinese people, right?
segments.zh: 对。因为，你知道，我们赚了这么多钱。所以显然，你知道，很多中国富人，对吧？

segments.en: So they use the trade channel to move money overseas, right?
segments.zh: 所以他们利用贸易渠道把钱转移到海外，对吧？

segments.en: So that's why they're cracking down on overseas trusts as well.
segments.zh: 所以这就是为什么他们也在打击海外信托。

segments.en: And also, you know, many of the Chinese exporters, you know, when they export their goods overseas and then take the US dollars and then they keep the US dollars in the offshore account and to invest, right?
segments.zh: 而且，很多中国出口商把商品卖到海外后，拿到美元就留在离岸账户里进行配置。

segments.en: So you get phenomenal capital gain on the US stocks.
segments.zh: 所以你能从美国市场获得可观的资本利得。

segments.en: And, you know, if you're not into stocks, you can get like 6% yield on the, on the treasury bond as well.
segments.zh: 而且，如果你不参与权益资产，也能从国债获得约6%的收益率。

segments.en: And you're saying the, the revenue cycle coincides with the US semiconductor cycle?
segments.zh: 你是说收入周期与美国半导体周期同步？

segments.en: That's right. That's why it actually leads. So as you can see, right?
segments.zh: 没错，所以它实际上领先。如你所见。

segments.en: So because on one hand, you know, if you're, if you're a Chinese investor, on one hand, you know, you're getting a two years ago, you're getting a depreciating Chinese yen at home.
segments.zh: 因为一方面，如果你是内地市场参与者，两年前你在本地面临的是人民币贬值。

segments.en: But then, you know, your export gross is phenomenal.
segments.zh: 但另一方面，你的出口总额非常可观。
